title: Choose a message
summary: R: Choose a message. Try score 3. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: if checks one true-or-false value. else chooses the other action.

blocks.text: Install R. Save an example as lesson.R and run Rscript lesson.R, or paste it into the R console.

blocks.title: Choose a message
blocks.code:
score <- 8
if (score >= 5) { cat("Pass\n") } else { cat("Try again\n") }

blocks.text: The single score passes the rule, so the first cat runs.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A whole vector is not one if condition; choose a single rule.
